lines.text: Fog on the water, a bell on the buoy
Counting the lights on the harbour wall
Every boat out is a boat coming home
And nobody answers the call
Low tide warning on the radio
Static and salt in the air
We set the lamps out along the shore
In case there is anyone there
Signal from the shallows, signal from the deep
Three short flashes and a long one
Signal from the shallows, we are wide awake
Waiting on the morning to come
Chart on the table, a cup gone cold
Pencil lines where the current runs
Somebody said it would clear by dawn
Somebody always does
Signal from the shallows, signal from the deep
Three short flashes and a long one
Signal from the shallows, we are wide awake
Waiting on the morning to come
And when the water lets the sand back through
We will walk out to the sound
Pick up the lamps one by one
And carry them back into town
